preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 31 narrates the death of Saul and Jonathan at Gilboa. 4QSamᵃ preserves fragments. The chapter has a parallel in 1 Chronicles 10 with some textual differences; 4QSamᵃ's evidence is fragmentary.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording variants only. The death-on-Gilboa narrative tracks MT.

variant_notes: Saul's suicide on his sword — to avoid capture by the uncircumcised — tracks MT. The 1 Chronicles 10:4 parallel reads identically.
